bounded_contexts.name: llm-gateway
bounded_contexts.description: Clean-room agent-dispatch gateway: a reverse-proxy that multiplexes the AI-agent fleet over pooled Codex/Claude/OpenAI/Gemini API keys. The kernel crate owns the pure key-pool state machine (round-robin selection, per-key failure-count blacklist threshold, jittered cooldown timestamps, success-reset/restore, provider-channel enum). The rest crate owns the axum reverse proxy with true SSE streaming passthrough, per-provider channel adapters injecting the right auth header, configurable failover/retry with next-key rotation and jittered backoff, two constant-time auth realms (admin + ingress proxy-key), Prometheus /metrics, hash-only structured logging, and OpenBao-sourced pooled keys. Reimplements the *concept* of an LLM key-pool reverse proxy; no third-party source was read or copied. No production deployment, persistence, tenant-runtime, or measured SLO is claimed by CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.

contracts.contract_status: no published OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/proto contract; the gateway is a transparent reverse proxy that forwards arbitrary provider-native request/response bodies byte-for-byte. The only gateway-owned surface is the ingress path scheme (/proxy/{group}/{*rest}), the admin/ingress auth header (x-oya-proxy-key), /healthz, and /metrics.

slos_non_claim: OpenSLO objects are AUTHORED design targets (provisional starting hypotheses per the research brief §4; no official vendor SLO exists for TTFT/latency). CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001 has no measured/burning SLO; targets are replaced with measured baselines once the gateway is live.

LLM Gateway production design-spec package (PRD, OpenAPI 3.2.0 / AsyncAPI 3.1.0 / proto3 contracts, Cedar, OpenSLO, runbooks, threat-model + design dossier)

regulatory_packs.applies_because: The gateway brokers AI inference; EU-resident tenants' prompts/completions may constitute high-risk processing requiring complete, immutable invocation audit (every model call recorded).
KR-resident tenant prompts/completions may carry personal information; body-spill and audit are KR-region pinned with no cross-region movement.
Immutable, hash-chained, access-controlled audit with alert-if-disabled provides the security/availability control evidence for the inference egress chokepoint.
Vault-only secrets, constant-time auth, hash-only logging, per-tenant isolation, and access-controlled audit map to ISO 27001 Annex A controls for a credential-brokering proxy.

regulatory_packs_non_claim: regulatory_packs declare the data-residency/audit packs the DESIGNED gateway is built to satisfy (prompts/completions may carry tenant PII). CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001 makes no live-deployment compliance-attestation claim; pack controls are design-stage per IP-001.

adrs.title: Per-microservice flat layout; new microservices ship under microservices/<ms>/

LLM gateway production design: provider-abstraction + canonical OpenAI-compatible surface, key-pool resilience state machine + per-tenant pools honoring Retry-After, Bedrock-shaped immutable audit + default-off body logging, OpenSLO SLI set

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: Per-key failure-count blacklist threshold + jittered cooldown in oya-llm-gateway-kernel acts as a per-upstream-key circuit breaker (open on N consecutive failures, half-open on cooldown expiry via lazy restore). No cross-process shared breaker is claimed.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: not_claimed_runtime — the gateway authenticates ingress proxy-keys but does not implement per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting in CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: Prometheus /metrics exposes request outcomes, per-key success/failure, retries, upstream latency histogram, and active-key gauge (oya_llm_gateway_*). Scrape wiring to Alloy/VictoriaMetrics is deployment-time, not claimed here.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: not_claimed_runtime — no OpenSLO target or burn-rate alert is authored for CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.

audit_chain.body_spill: default-off; per-tenant opt-in; redacted, residency-pinned object store referenced by prompt_uri/completion_uri
audit_chain.non_claim: audit_chain.enabled declares the DESIGNED production posture (ADR-0373). CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001 does not yet implement runtime audit-chain persistence; emission lands with the rest-crate wiring (IP-001 T6).

capacity_model.notes: CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001 is a code-backed local foundation. The binary builds and unit tests pass, but no live deployment, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, or SLO is claimed.

sharding_automation.non_claim: No key-pool shard split, group migration, or audit-chain persistence is implemented by CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.

dr.non_claim: Pooled keys are stateless cache from OpenBao; there is no gateway-owned persistent state to replicate. No warm standby, failover drill, or DR measurement is implemented by CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: The agent-dispatch gateway brokers pooled provider credentials and is intended Tier-2 isolation. CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001 has no runtime pod deployment; tier is retained as intended future isolation class only.

tenant_version_pinning.non_claim: The gateway is a transparent proxy with no per-tenant API version pinning runtime.

explicit_non_claims: No live deployment, k8s manifest, container image, OpenTofu plan/apply, provider-live smoke test, measured SLO, capacity telemetry, autoscaling, DR, or audit-chain runtime persistence is implemented by CS-LLM-GATEWAY-AGENT-DISPATCH-001.
Response bodies (including SSE streams) are forwarded byte-for-byte and are NEVER buffered, parsed, or logged. Prompts and completions are never inspected.

Pooled provider keys are read ONLY from OpenBao at runtime; no pooled key is read from a plaintext file or environment variable. The only secret read from the environment is the OpenBao token (BAO_TOKEN) plus the two auth-realm tokens (ADMIN_TOKEN, INGRESS_PROXY_KEYS), all injected from k8s Secrets at deploy.
The optional local-fallback encrypted key store requires an explicit operator passphrase (AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2) and never operates in plaintext.
